stem: How does the setting influence the plot of the story?

options.label: A
options.text: The conditions on the boat contribute to the conflict Pavel experiences.

options.label: B
options.text: The letter from Pavel's uncle introduces an important character.

options.label: C
options.text: The man standing in front of the soup pot provides comic relief.

options.label: D
options.text: Pavel's fellow passengers encourage him to remain hopeful about purchasing land.
